## Personality

A concise person who never wastes words, Clair Donnell is also described as a reasonable young fellow when things are explained to him. Although he harbors a desire to become a carpenter, his mother wants him to be guided toward becoming a college professor.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P13](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0013)_

## History

Clair Donnell was named Jacob after his uncle by his father, despite his mother's preference for a name she considered aristocratic. On [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, Clair's mother confronted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands regarding the pronunciation and spelling of her children's names. Clair later wrote a composition for his schoolwork, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) included in a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing humorous student writings.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P19](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0019), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +3 more_

## Quotes

> "and I have come in to see you about something Clarice Almira told me when she came home to dinner today. It annoyed me excessively."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

> "Clarice Almira told me that you pronounced our name Donnell. Now, Miss Shirley, the correct pronunciation of our name is Donnell . . . accent on the last syllable. I hope you’ll remember this in future."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015)

> "Certainly it is. And Clarice Almira also informed me that you call my son Jacob."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017)

> "Please, miss, I had to help ma make a pudding for dinner ’cause we’re expecting company and Clarice Almira’s sick,"
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007)

> "I am Mrs. Donnell . . . Mrs. H. B. Donnell,"
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--clair-donnell.md)

Clair Donnell is a pupil in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's schoolroom. He attends the school where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) teaches, though his interactions with her during classroom incidents remain unnoted.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006)_
